title: Discounted price on tokens?
body: This is extremely fun and productive to use but the costs add up pretty quickly. This is entirely your agent, it's closed source (except for the minified client) so we have kind of minimal control beyond `/compact`. It feels like there should be some 'volume pricing' discount or something because we're kind of a captive audience in a sense. It's not some generic coding agent like aider or cline where you can plug in an OpenAI or OpenRouter key.
author: tylerkahn
